note: Invented biographies for the stub A.I.M. mercenaries, keyed by stub profile id and compiled by pnpm stubs into binarydata/aimbios.edt at each profile's bio row of externalized/mercs-AIM-listings.json (400 and 160 units: the biography and the additional information). Original writing for ja2-node.

0: Kestrel learned to shoot on a hill farm and never lost the habit of patience. She prefers the long view and the quiet approach.
Allergic to cats. Insists on carrying her own maps.
1: Vant spent ten years guarding convoys across three borders. He talks little and checks his gear twice.
2: Moraga trained as a field medic before she picked up a rifle. She keeps a squad alive and expects it to return the favour.
Will not work night shifts two days in a row.
3: Hollis is a demolitions man who believes every problem has a fuse somewhere. His employers mostly agree.
4: Tarrow was a mechanic for a racing team and still treats every engine like a patient.
5: Orrin is a scout who moves like weather. Few people see him arrive and fewer see him leave.
6: Lasko served as a sergeant and still counts heads at every halt. Recruits like him; officers fear him.
7: Puig grew up near the coast and swims better than he walks. He is cheerful under fire and grumpy at breakfast.
8: Marlow was a radio operator who now prefers louder instruments. He has a steady hand and an unsteady sense of humour.
9: Reede keeps to herself and to her rifle. Clients hire her for the jobs that must not be talked about.
10: Voss came up through a mountain unit and hates the lowlands. He climbs anything and complains about everything.
11: Arden is the newest name on the list and the most eager. She has a lot to prove and the skill to prove it.
